checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Stocks and ETFs
facts.text: Eligible Robinhood investing-account stock and ETF trades have no trading commission. This does not remove regulatory or other account charges.

facts.label: Stock and ETF options
facts.text: No commission or contract fee for stock and ETF options. Applicable regulatory and clearing charges still need to be considered.

facts.label: Index options
facts.text: Index options have a different fee structure, including contract and exchange charges. Review the current fee schedule for the exact symbol and account plan.
